name: jsonkit
description: Read and reshape one JSON document.
tokens: Every input is a string token. An input's schema describes the value one token must satisfy, and each token of a multiple option or a variadic argument satisfies it alone. The configuration schema describes the configuration the application reads, not a token. A null schema means the accepted shape is unknown, not that every token is accepted. An example's command holds the tokens after the application name.

exitCodes.1: Expected action failure, internal failure, or invalid declarations
exitCodes.130: Cancelled by SIGINT, a caller-supplied abort, or the action's cancel()
exitCodes.141: Stopped because the reader of stdout closed the pipe

encodings.json: The output is one JSON document. Unless the Command's view reshapes it, a value result is the value and a rows result is the array of its rows.
encodings.jsonl: Each line is one JSON document: one line per element when the printed value is an array, nothing for an empty array, and one line otherwise. Unless the view reshapes it, a rows result prints one line per row.

globals.name: verbose

command.name: get
command.description: Read one value at a path.
details: Quote a path that holds a shell metacharacter.

A path is a dot-separated walk from the root of the document.

- A **key** reads an object's member, such as `user.name`.
- A **whole number** reads an array's item, such as `items.0`.

The document is *JSON*; see [the format](https://www.json.org/json-en.html).

failures.meaning: The path names no value in the document.
The document is not valid JSON.

options.name: file
options.description: The document to read. Omit it to read piped text.
